Looking at the z-index values and paint order:

- **root>back**: z-index 1 (paints first)
- **root>front**: z-index 2 (paints second)
- **root>middle**: z-index 3 (paints last)

All three boxes contain the point 120,120. The point falls within:
- root>back (x=40-240, y=40-240)
- root>front (x=100-160, y=100-160)
- root>middle (x=80-280, y=80-280)

Since elements with higher z-index values paint on top of elements with lower z-index values, **root>middle** (z-index 3) paints last and therefore appears on top at the point 120,120, obscuring the boxes beneath it.

ANSWER: root>middle
